tldr: Chiron transiting the 1st house: a long healing chapter around identity, body, visibility, and the way life meets the person directly.
body: Chiron moving through the 1st house can reopen old material around identity, body, visibility, and the way life meets the person directly. This is usually a long season, not a quick event, and it asks for patient work with the sore place rather than a rushed fix. The wound is bound to your identity and body; you may feel marked, awkward in your own skin, or 'too much / not enough' as a person.
business: For a year or more, the Chiron wound works through identity, body, visibility, and the way life meets the person directly. People trust you because your self-acceptance was earned, not handed to you.
shadow: Defining yourself by the injury, or armoring up so no one sees it.
advice: Tend the sore spot in the 1st house deliberately. Work with identity, body, visibility, and the way life meets the person directly as a healing chapter, not a crisis to fix fast.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Chiron house placement material.
